title: Wave 5 Phase 1 — Learning Time core session object + single-learner cockpit (time-only MVP)

phases.title: Phase 1 — learning_time_sessions table + migration
preconditions: Confirm DATABASE_URL points at a non-prod/throwaway database before running db:generate or db:migrate (per CLAUDE.md migration rules) — if this cannot be confirmed, fail this phase rather than running migrations against an unknown target
testsFirst: UPDATE/NEW db/__tests__/schema.test.ts: imports learningTimeSessions from db/schema.ts and asserts it defines householdId, learnerId, subjectId, lessonTaskId, timeChannelType, targetMinutes, scheduledStart, scheduledEnd, status, startedAt, pausedAt, endedAt, endedBy, outcome, notes columns (fails until the table is added)
implementationSteps: Add a learningTimeSessions pgTable to db/schema.ts per the plan's schema block (docs/bug_enhancement/20260611-wave5-learning-time-screen-plan.md, 'Data model / contract changes'): id, householdId (-> households.id), learnerId (-> learners.id), subjectId? (-> subjects.id), lessonTaskId? (-> lessonTasks.id), timeChannelType ('scheduled'|'stopwatch'|'timer'), targetMinutes?, scheduledStart?, scheduledEnd?, status ('draft'|'running'|'paused'|'ended'|'finalized'), startedAt?, pausedAt?, endedAt?, endedBy? ('time'|'manual'), outcome? ('complete'|'partial'|'abandoned'), notes?, createdAt, updatedAt, plus index learning_time_sessions_household_learner_idx on (householdId, learnerId)
Do NOT add a 'mode' column in this phase — Phase 1 is time-only; 'mode' is added in Phase 2 (see plan doc, 'mode field is deliberately omitted')
Run npm run db:generate to produce the migration
Run npm run db:migrate to apply it
doneWhen: RUN: npm run db:generate (produces exactly one new migration matching the schema change)
RUN: npm run db:migrate (applies cleanly, no gap in migration sequence)
phases.writeBack: Added learning_time_sessions table (columns per plan doc, FK cascade behavior should match subject_resources/subjectLearners precedent — record what onDelete behavior was chosen for each FK and why). Record the migration file number/range so the next phase can confirm nothing was skipped.
